known.message: S04 offers to open the dashboard edited last even when the member has no dashboards, with no empty first-visit alternative. Fix: Add an alternative 'when the member has no dashboards yet' that reads that there is no last-edited dashboard yet and points to Create in the frame instead of offering to open the dashboard they edited last. (addressed in the final fix, not re-reviewed)

openedFrom includes FR02, which is a frame, not a screen that opens the dialog. Fix: Remove FR02 so openedFrom lists only S05, the screen with a step that opens D01 (addressed in the final fix, not re-reviewed)

The Delete way out does not say where it leads: it never says it closes the dialog or goes to a route. Fix: Change the Delete step to say it closes the dialog, such as: Can choose Delete, which removes the widget, saves automatically, closes the dialog and shows the dashboard without the widget. (addressed in the final fix, not re-reviewed)

The step merges two different actions into one by asking for Note text plus Counter label and Counter number together though a widget is only one type. Fix: Replace S03 with type-specific steps, such as one step that edits only Note text (FD07) for a note widget and another step that edits only Counter label (FD08) and Counter number (FD09) for a counter widget, each saving automatically and updating the dashboard last edited time. (addressed in the final fix, not re-reviewed)
